title: PVDX Telemetry (SatNOGS)

list.name: station
list.label: Ground station
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "ground_station", predicate: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}", start: -30d)

panels.title: Frames in range

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frame_id")
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.description: Decoded frames written to InfluxDB in the selected time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frame_id")
  |> group(columns: ["observation_id"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Stations in range

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frame_id")
  |> group(columns: ["ground_station"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.description: Distinct ground stations that received frames.

panels.title: Last frame received

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frame_id")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "last_frame", _value: float(v: int(v: r._time)) / 1000000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.description: Timestamp of the newest frame (frame time from the SatNOGS file name).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frame_id")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) }))

panels.title: Battery / bus voltages

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(${voltage_fields:regex})$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "ground_station"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.description: Pick any decoded numeric field(s) with the 'field' variable at the top.

panels.title: Frames by station

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frame_id")
  |> group(columns: ["station_name"])
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["station_name", "_value"])

panels.description: Which SatNOGS stations delivered the frames.

panels.title: Latest values (all fields)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.norad_cat_id == "${norad}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ground_station =~ /^(${station:regex})$/)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> last()
  |> toString()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "observation_id", "station_name"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_field"])

panels.description: Most recent value of every decoded field, with the observation and station it came from.

description: Decoded SatNOGS frames written by pvdx-decode. Every panel is decoder-agnostic: fields are picked by dashboard variables, so swapping in the PVDX decoder needs no dashboard change.
